lines.text: Pease porridge hot, pease porridge cold, in the pot nine days old!
Have you ever seen that strange thin skin sitting on top of your warm hot cocoa?
Don't worry, it's not plastic—it's pure kitchen science!
Warm milk is packed with friendly proteins and tiny drops of healthy fat!
As steam rises, water evaporates quickly from the very top surface!
The milk proteins dry out and tangle together, forming a delicate edible blanket!
Just stir it with a spoon or whisk, and it melts right back into chocolatey goodness!
Now you know the delicious food chemistry behind Pease Porridge Hot!
